facts.fact: ICT minister Raafat Hendy said on 2026-09-22 that Egypt launched phase one of its National AI Strategy in 2019 and is now implementing phase two, the National AI Strategy 2025-2030, built on six pillars (governance, technology, data, infrastructure, ecosystem, human capacity).
facts.system: الاستراتيجية الوطنية للذكاء الاصطناعي 2025-2030 (National AI Strategy, second phase)

facts.fact: The minister listed the National AI Council as formed within the national AI framework alongside the strategy and the Applied Innovation Center; the source gives no formation date and does not say the Council was given the job of carrying out the strategy, so this is stated as of the document date.
facts.system: المجلس الوطني للذكاء الاصطناعي (National AI Council)
